scope: Synthetic cold native Model ObjectStroke -> Drawing GLV1/RTV1 host-Mesa control compared to the default public SVG export, rasterized with resvg on a 1920x1080 white page at one pixel per page unit. Native transparent premultiplied RGBA was composited once over white; native lower-left readback was flipped vertically.
reproduction: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/sdocx-agent-target CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 cargo test -p sdocx --lib --features pdf,serde public_svg_fallback_differs_from_v17_native_frame -- --nocapture
limitations: One synthetic host capture and one SVG rasterizer; this is not a saved-note, device, arbitrary-scale, or PDF comparison. It measures white-paper RGB, not intrinsic alpha.
